lines.text: As the crystal shatters, four huge shields fall to the ground.
The shields possess a mirror sheen, reflecting the surrounding environment off their surfaces.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Doesn't look much like a shoe to me.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Like I told you, Glass Slippers cannot be compromised.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They fed the Harmony Cube fragments to the crystal so that it would expand and cover Glass Slippers.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They wanted to keep this weapon for themselves at any cost.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Why would they want a weapon that they couldn't use?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Perhaps they consider it a legendary weapon of some kind. That's probably why they also decorated the path.
The familiar and terrifying sound of glass breaking fills the air.
Everyone unleashes a maelstrom of bullets and missiles,
but it does nothing to stop Behemoth.
She receives the full brunt of the assault and continues to charge forward unfazed.
Behemoth approaches without slowing down, snatching Grave with her clamp and hurling her into a nearby wall.
Crystals shatter all around, sending fragments flying.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: First up, the brains of the operation.
One of the crystals has pierced my abdomen.
I feel my legs give way, and I fall to my knees.
You can't touch my blood! Don't come close!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wh-what are you saying?! If you don't stop the bleeding...
I'll be fine! Just stay back!
My vision is getting hazy. Everything sounds far off and muffled.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: ... der! Stop the bleeding..! Get... together...!
I have to get up and command them.
How long have I been out?
Everyone is lying on the ground, motionless.
The only one I can't see...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Any other tricks up your sleeve?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Some kind of secret weapon or something along those lines?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Once I took you out, the rest of them came tumbling down like dominoes.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I doubt Grave will divulge how to open this coffin.
Behemoth picks up the coffin with her clamps.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I really wanted to meet her.
Behemoth breaks the coffin open with her clamps.
There is a small burst of sparks, and the sounds and vibrations emanating from the coffin cease.
I frantically look around in search of Grave,
and see her standing in front of a tall crystal which is bathed in darkness.
Inside that crystal, a figure can faintly be made out.
When we were fighting Glass Slippers...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You have no idea how much that pisses me off.
Rapi hurls herself at Behemoth and slams her fist into her face.
Behemoth's jaw becomes slightly warped, but other than that, there is no discernible damage.
One of her clamps sends Rapi flying back.
Get up... I have to get up!
I have to do something! Anything!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Wow, look at you standing up.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That must have hurt like hell.
I hurl the disk at Behemoth,
and it feebly lands between her feet.

lines.speaker: mana_op
lines.text: Skipping all sequences. Proceeding straight to activation upon impact.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I'm starting to get sick of this.
Just as Behemoth's clamp reaches out...
Sparks fly from Behemoth's clamp as it stops dead in its tracks.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's a hit, but slightly to the right.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Adjusting the coordinates. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I will say that's one good thing about these crystals.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You don't have to adjust your aim every single time.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The only downside is that they have a time limit.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'll fire off a bit more.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I want her to feel the same pain she's inflicted on us.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Argh! What a thorn in my side you all are!
Vesti rushes in under the incoming A Pillar before it hits the ground, and it lands directly on her shoulders.
Carrying the now bent A Pillar on her shoulders, Vesti uses her entire body to hurl the stake.
With a swing of her clamp, Behemoth knocks away the A Pillar.
Seizing the opportunity, Vesti dives in close and tackles Behemoth.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Your offenses are useless if I'm up close.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I could say the same thing to you.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Don't be so sure about that.
Vesti unleashes a volley of missiles into Behemoth at point-blank range.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What is this, a suicide attack?
A massive explosion engulfs the area.
Something flies out of the smoke and lands in front of me.
It's Vesti, who has been sliced in two.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Comm... ander... Sorry... I couldn't... win...
We continue our assault on Behemoth, but nothing seems to work.
Behemoth uses her clamps to clasp onto a giant chunk of crystal
and then flings it towards the sound of the gunfire.
An explosion rings out in the distance, and the gunshots stop.
I lurch forward, barely hanging onto consciousness.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Her body is fine, and the linking went well.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Has it simply been too long?
Grave is hit by Behemoth's attack and is sent hurling backwards.
Behemoth stands before Cinderella, who remains trapped inside the crystal.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: While I appreciate you trying to fix her up,
Behemoth clamps onto the crystal, creating cracks and fissures through it.
The Nikke dressed in pale blue lies on the ground, surrounding by crystal shards.
And then, she opens her crimson eyes.
Cinderella is a blank slate now and highly impressionable.
We can't allow Behemoth to corrupt her.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What's wrong? Is your memory a bit spotty?
she was unsure what would happen to a Nikke if they were exposed to my blood.
Whatever happens, it can't get any worse than how things are going now.
And so I swing my blood-soaked fist at Behemoth

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: A human stepping up to me?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Would you like to join us?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We don't usually add new members to the team, but I'll make an exception for y...

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: It's over... Cinderella has been corrupted.
Grave puts her hand to her heart.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Now I will do what must be done, with my own hands.
You can still have what you've fought for!
Yes, there still must be hope...

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: We can erase all that shame.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Let's write a new story together.
and touches the tip of Grave's helmet with her fingertips.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: My voice has changed as well.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: It may not sound familiar to you anymore.
looking at the scar-riddled visage before her.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: What we were supposed to do long ago.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: What we wanted to accomplish so badly but were unable to.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will rewrite this story, and continue it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I don't know what came over me... did I eat some bad food or something?
She has more or less recovered from the Vapaus.
Behemoth spreads her arms wide and flashes a big smile.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Anachiro, what are you waiting for?
A bright blue light is glowing, casting a scattered panoply of illumination.
Amongst this light, Cinderella, awoken from her slumber,
confronts the enemy enveloped in darkness.
It's like a scene from the legends of old.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: A story that was once defiled and kept from the world.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Now, in this place, in this very moment,

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hold on, what are you doing?! Wait!
